title: Hays County grass ID candidate staging queue
provenance: iNaturalist /observations/species_counts, research grade, county Hays; compared to 112 source records and their stored synonyms
selection_rules: Only taxa with research-grade iNaturalist observations inside Hays County; do not infer nativity/wild establishment or trust iNaturalist determinations uncritically
exclusion_rules: Exclude non-Hays observations from active phase (preserved in original full 12-county audit); do not add established aliases as new cards
editorial_guardrails: Preserve existing 112, photos, arrows, diagrams and morphology during review.
Do not create species.json records, publish cards, or trigger main-branch auto-sync until manual source verification.
Review each taxon name against Flora of North Central Texas / Flora of North America, along with current accepted names, before proposing incorporation.
Source IDs and plant associations require image/location check. iNaturalist research-grade alone is insufficient.
Keep introduced grasses eligible for field ID, but label them; cultivated ornamental/lawn observations require establishment review.
County focus is for encounter/ID coverage. BONAP NAPA nativity certification is a later independent gate.
Archive regional candidate list; never delete the historical full audit.
iNaturalist has matching research-grade photographed wild-tagged observations for all 58 candidates; this documents reported sightings only, NOT expert-confirmed identity or establishment.

candidates.name_notes: Kew accepts separately; check local specimen and distinction from other Paspalum.
candidates.independent_voucher_qa: Three source specimen sheets and readable labels inspected: two 2021 conservation/upland collections and one 2019 yard collection; all show narrow racemose flowering branches. Species-level first-glume and papillose hair details not resolved.
candidates.herbarium_collector_metadata_discrepancy: 2019 label Thomas J. Watson; 2021 labels Thomas L. Watson; GBIF records all under Thomas J. Watson.
candidates.cultivated_establishment_review: 2019 yard ambiguous; 2021 slope 'many plants' and Onion Creek floodplain 'five plants' support naturally growing Hays populations but establishment needs confirmation.
candidates.highres_next_exact_anatomy: Take 10×–20× photos of both spikelet faces from a verified Hays sample; isolate first glume and short papillose-based hairs; compare P. pubiflorum.

candidates.name_notes: Kew accepts separately but published native range in Argentina; Texas determinations need voucher review.
GENERIC_PLACEMENT_DISAGREEMENT: POWO uses Rottboellia campestris; USDA GRIN lists Mnesithea cylindrica. No species merged into old list.
candidates.highres_next_exact_anatomy: Remove one rachis joint and photograph pit and sessile/pedicellate pair at about 5×–10× with mm scale.
Oblique macro of sheath hairs at bases, then detach a ripe spikelet beside millimeter rule.
Isolate a spikelet showing the second glume face and blunt tip, plus scaled inner ligule.
Detach one whole internode + spikelet unit, show two glumes and florets with mm scale.

candidates.name_notes: Kew accepts this separately; older treatment under Tridens muticus var. elongatus. Do not auto-merge with Tridentopsis mutica.
candidates.independent_voucher_qa: Two returned Hays TEX specimens were Tridens muticus var. muticus (Tridentopsis mutica), not elongata; do not use them as positive voucher evidence.
candidates.highres_next_exact_anatomy: Flatten a mature second glume on contrasting background; illuminate the veins, measure to 0.5 mm, photograph blade width.
Separate a mature lemma, photograph a split/cleft apex with a millimeter rule and compare Tridens flavus.
Photograph detached mature florets from this specimen, both glumes, and roots/rhizome system; reconcile with older Panicum antidotale key.
Dissect one fully ripe lemma; fan out all appendages under scope and count with 1-mm scale.
Measure fertile and sterile florets on the shown loose spikelets, and compare to independently verified S. ciliata at identical scale.

photo_visual_qa_progress.latest_review: All 58 Hays candidate name records triaged, but only 51 visually inspected. Seven research-grade Hays one-observation taxa still need photo-level permissible access or alternative voucher evidence. All species-level identification signoffs pending.
